name: Motion for a resolution
title: MOTION FOR A RESOLUTION on organisational mismanagement of European Personnel Selection Office (EPSO) competitions
part_text:
The European Parliament is not changing any law here. It is passing a resolution, which is a formal opinion. It calls on the European Commission and the EU staff selection office (EPSO) to fix repeated failures in recruitment exams: cancelled tests, technical problems, long delays and poor replies to complaints. It asks for an independent review, the option of taking tests in person, better complaint handling, and a report back to Parliament within six months.

- **What changes:** Nothing yet. It is a set of demands, not a law.
- **Who it affects:** Candidates for EU jobs and EPSO, the EU recruitment office.
- **What happens next:** The Commission must report back to Parliament within six months.
